channel.title: Pier & Point · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment) (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): In February 2025 Port staff…
item.description: In February 2025 Port staff listed the paseos around Building G among the Phase 1 improvements put to the Port Commission for acceptance; a June 2026 Port staff report (dated June 5) says the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure without naming this paseo. No Port document read says what Exposition Street is called now. Source: https://sfport.com/media/10214/download; https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf; https://sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%2010B%20Mission%20Rock%20New%20Street%20Names%20Staff%20Report.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): The January 30, 2018 Design…
item.description: The January 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone now says the street or open-space name comes from the April 24, 2018 final version of the Design Controls, and cites the Port's January 2018 and September 2019 memos for the approval. Those memos give different resolution numbers (18-04 and 18-05). Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf; https://sfport.com/media/3259/download.

item.title: Added · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): Added a record for the Bridgeview…
item.description: Added a record for the Bridgeview Street paseo. Source: https://sfport.com/media/10214/download.

item.title: Correction · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): The status stays complete…
item.description: The status stays complete, but the record's notes and its earlier change entry no longer say the paseo was built on the strength of the 2019 Phase 1 submittal, which was only a forecast. They now cite the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes (staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G) and the Port's June 2026 report (Phase 1 completed in 2025; the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure); neither names this paseo individually. The Jan 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone now cites the Sep 2019 Port memo that states the date, and notes that the memo numbers that resolution 18-05 while the January 26 staff report requested it as 18-04. Source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2025-02-11 (https://sfport.com/media/10214/download); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Phase 2 update (Port Commission Item 11A), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf).
item.source: Port of San Francisco, Port Commission minutes, 2025-02-11 (https://sfport.com/media/10214/download); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Phase 2 update (Port Commission Item 11A), 2026-06-09 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 7A staff report, 2019-09-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf)

item.title: Correction · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): The Feb 11, 2025 milestone…
item.description: The Feb 11, 2025 milestone said the Port Commission accepted Mission Rock Phase 1's streets and paseos 'including this one'. The minutes record Resolution 25-05 authorizing Port staff to accept the public infrastructure the developer built (streets, sidewalks, parks and open spaces), with Board of Supervisors action still to follow, and do not name this paseo individually. The milestone now says so, and cites the Port's June 2026 memo, which says the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure. Source: Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (https://www.sfport.com/media/10214/download); https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf.

item.title: Added · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): The Bridgeview Street paseo…
item.description: The Bridgeview Street paseo between the Visa building and Block K added on its real lot. The 2019 Phase 1 submittal planned it as part of Phase 1; the Port Commission's Feb 11, 2025 minutes record staff's request to accept Phase 1's public infrastructure, including the paseos around Building G (Resolutions 25-05, 25-06), and the Port's June 2026 report says Phase 1 was completed in 2025 and the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure. Source: 2019 Phase 1 submittal; Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (sfport.com/media/10214); Port Item 11A memo, June 5 2026; DataSF Parcels.
item.source: 2019 Phase 1 submittal; Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (sfport.com/media/10214); Port Item 11A memo, June 5 2026; DataSF Parcels

item.title: Milestone · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): Port staff report dated June… (Jun 5, 2026)
item.description: Port staff report dated June 5, 2026 (for the Commission meeting of June 9, 2026) says the Developer completed Phase 1 in 2025 and 'the City has accepted all public infrastructure, including parks, streets, and public utilities within the Phase' (Jun 5, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-09.

item.title: Milestone · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): Port Commission passes… (Feb 11, 2025)
item.description: Port Commission passes Resolutions 25-05 and 25-06 unanimously to accept Phase 1 public infrastructure; staff describe 'the paseos in the bottom around Building G leading in to China Basin Park' as Port owned (Feb 11, 2025). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-02-11.

item.title: Complete · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): Port Commission authorizes… (Feb 11, 2025)
item.description: Port Commission authorizes Port staff to accept the public infrastructure the developer built at Mission Rock, including streets, sidewalks, parks and open spaces, and approves management and related agreements (Resolutions 25-05, 25-06); the minutes do not name this paseo individually, and the Port's June 2026 memo says the City has accepted all Phase 1 public infrastructure (Feb 11, 2025). Source: Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (Res. 25-05/25-06); Port Commission memo, June 5 2026 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf).
item.source: Port Commission minutes, Feb 11 2025 (Res. 25-05/25-06); Port Commission memo, June 5 2026 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf)

item.title: Milestone · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): Phase 1 submittal says Phase… (Jul 2, 2019)
item.description: Phase 1 submittal says Phase 1 'will also complete the Shared Public Way and Bridgeview Street paseos north of Exposition Street' (Jul 2, 2019). Source: Mission Rock Partners (developer's submittal to the Port), 2019-07-02.
item.source: Mission Rock Partners (developer's submittal to the Port), 2019-07-02

item.title: Milestone · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): Final Design Controls… (Apr 24, 2018)
item.description: Final Design Controls (document dated April 24, 2018) lists the Bridgeview Street paseo in Figure 3.1.1 as 'Section 4.4 Paseo: Bridgeview Street' (Apr 24, 2018). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2018-04-24.

item.title: Planned · Bridgeview Street paseo (Bridgeview Way, north segment): Port Commission approves the… (Jan 30, 2018)
item.description: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls (their April 24, 2018 final version names this planned street Bridgeview Street (Section 4.4, p.98; the earlier version the Commission approved was not read)); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sep 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05) (Jan 30, 2018). Source: Port Commission Item 11A staff report, Jan 26 2018 (request), https://sfport.com/media/3259/download; Port Commission Item 7A memo, Sep 20 2019 (approval date), https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%207A%20Mission%20Rock%20Phase%201%20Budget%20Approval%20%28003%29.pdf; Mission Rock Design Controls, April 24 2018 final version (street name), https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf.
